title: Northgate Card Payment Terms — Crediting, Allocation, Automatic Payments and Credit Balances
content:
**Channels and crediting.** Payments on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account are accepted through the card's payment channels; a payment received by the card's payment cutoff time Eastern on a business day is credited that day, otherwise on the next business day, and a cash payment at a Northgate register may not exceed the card's largest single in-store cash payment.

**Account status.** Payments are accepted on an account in active, suspended, closed or charged-off status, as the system record of the card account shows it. They are not accepted on an application in applied or declined status.

**Allocation.** The minimum payment is applied as the issuer chooses, and any amount above it is applied by the card's payment allocation (highest APR first), except in the last two cycles of a special financing period, where payment above the minimum is applied first to that promotional balance.

**Automatic payments.** Automatic payments may be set to one of the card's automatic payment options and are drawn on the payment due date.

**Credit balances.** A payment larger than the balance leaves a credit balance.

**Credit balance refund clause — no longer in force.** The clause "a credit balance above the card's credit balance refund minimum is refunded within the card's refund business days of the cardholder's written request, and any credit balance above that amount remaining after the card's automatic refund months is refunded without a request" is **no longer in force** as written here. It is superseded by the current basis for refunding credit balances.

**Hypothetical crediting cases.**

| Payment received (hypothetical) | Credited |
|---|---|
| business day, before the cutoff time | that day |
| business day, after the cutoff time | the next business day |
| a day that is not a business day | the next business day |

superseded_clauses: a credit balance above credit_balance_refund_min_usd is refunded within credit_balance_refund_business_days business days of the cardholder's written request, and any credit balance above that amount remaining after credit_balance_auto_refund_months months is refunded without a request.
